Great Value
Jun 2018 • Family
My teenage son was craving some protein. So after a quick search on the net found Nam Son across the road at the rear of our accommodation (Sherwood Residence) Walked in and seated, drinks and meals ordered and quicker than it takes to get a Big Mac our steaks were sizzling on a hot plate in front of us. Now at around AUD $3 - 4 a steak I wasn't expecting much. It was great, tender and tasty. My son had two. Drinks, 4 steaks, 2 chicken dishes, big fresh bread rolls with all meals. Under AUD $25 for family of 5.

I loved the flavors!
Jan 2018 • Friends
We found this place as a result of consulting our Lonely Planet book when we were looking for something in the area. As soon as we were welcomed in by a very friendly lady, we were given a menu and, upon seeing our indecision (we were considering some kind of beef combination plate), the lady said she would bring us a special. We were feeling adventurous, so we thought sure! We ordered a coconut water in the meantime - yum! So refreshing! 

A short time later, she brought out a sizzling platter of a very thin steak, one meatball, a piece of pate, a fried egg, and then sides of salad, fries, and a big bun. As it turned out, the steak was flavored so nicely, I craved it for days afterward! Even though the sizzling plate looked small, it was actually a great amount of food! I think we get too used to having such big servings in the west, which is really unnecessary and wasteful. We were pleasantly sated, and very pleased with a meal that was delicious and a great value - everything cost us about $5 Canadian!

Excellent and affordable steaks
Aug 2017 • Couples
This restaurant has excellent steaks that are very satisfying. They are marinated and cooked to perfection. They bring fries right away, they are 15k, but if you don't want them you can just say no. The food comes with a loaf of bread that is great for soaking up the tasty juices or the egg. The ostrich steak was one of the most tender cuts of meat I have ever had. We left with two steaks, two banh mi loaves of bread, two beers, and fries for around $10 USD. Service is bad by American standards, but pretty typical of Vietnam. I would highly recommend this place to anyone.

Worst steak ever in sad local eating-place
Sep 2015 • Friends
Chose this restaurant because it was mentioned in the Lonely Planet.
It appears to be a very cheap eating place in all aspects. For me it doesn't even earn the name "restaurant".
Steak was terrible, like leather and not a good taste. I couldn't even get it chewed away.
Before you sit down, there is already a plate of french fries and a basket of bread on the table. Without asking it appears on your bill at the end.
Nobody speaks any English, so they don't understand your order and a discussion over the check is impossible.
This restaurant should not be adviced in any travel guide.
